messages:
Priya: quick UI review — noticed modals feel visually cramped on the dashboard. header baseline looks like it's 8px off from body copy and CTA sits too close to content. also toasts overlap the primary CTA on compact widths. attaching screenshots: https://img.redwood/mock/modal-compact.png
Marco: agree. looks like the modal uses `space-3` inside but the header uses `space-2` margin-bottom. can we standardize on a `modal-vertical-rhythm` token? maybe values: `modal-vr-regular` and `modal-vr-compact`.
Lena: accessibility note: when the toast appears it steals focus on keyboard flows. we should ensure toasts are non-focusable by default and focus trap stays in modal. also check screen reader announcement order.
Jordan: CTA copy: right now primary says "Save" but action is more like "Apply changes" — ambiguous. suggest "Apply" or keep "Save changes". small wording tweak but helps clarity when toasts show "Changes applied" vs "Saved".
Sam: for toast stacking precedence — current logic adds new toasts at top, which ends up covering header CTAs on small modals. can we change to append at bottom or pin to top of viewport instead of modal container? might be easier to scope to `.app-portal` so toasts float above modals.
Priya: good call on portal. design intent was to avoid covering core controls. prefer toasts anchored to top-right of viewport for desktop, bottom for mobile. for modals specifically, they should not be in the modal stacking context.
Marco: proposed CSS snippet for portal approach:
```
/* toast root mounted in document body */
.toast-root { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 1100; }
.modal { z-index: 1000; }
```
That keeps toasts visually above but off the modal. if we want below header CTAs, invert z-indexs accordingly.
Lena: focus ring concern — primary buttons inside modal currently use `box-shadow` based ring which is low contrast on dark-mode. please ensure `:focus-visible` uses `outline` fallback. also keyboard order: make sure cancel/close are reachable before destructive actions.
Jordan: microcopy proposal — use these variants: `Apply changes`, `Discard`, `Cancel`. in confirmations toast text should exactly mirror the CTA language: e.g., `Changes applied` not `Saved`. small but helps mental model.
Sam: implementation detail: we have `toast.stackPosition = 'top' | 'bottom'` in the toast service. default is `top`. propose adding `portal: true` flag and `avoidSelectors: ['.modal__content']` to prevent overlap. backend UX folks ok with that? @Priya
Priya: yes, add `portal: true` and add `modal-avoid` behavior. please add unit tests for 320px width (phone) and 1024px (desktop) so we don't regress.
DesignBot: snapshot test added for `modal-vertical-rhythm` tokens and toast portal behavior (run id 202a3f).
Marco: I'll follow up with a PR to expose `modal-vr-regular`/`-compact` tokens and wire them into Modal and Dialog components. will add a migration note in changelog.
Lena: i'll run an a11y sweep after the PR lands — keyboard, screen reader order, and color contrast for focus states.
Jordan: tiny nit — consider increasing tappable area of modal close icon to 44px hit target without changing visual spacing. simple padding tweak.
Priya: love that. can we keep modal compact variant for settings panels and regular for flows with forms? let's document usage in the component docs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
